54: }

56: static void ap_uart0_log_task(beken_thread_arg_t arg)
57: {
58: 	uint8_t buffer[MB_CHNL_BUFF_LEN];
59: 
60: 	(void)arg;
61: 	for (;;)
62: 	{
63: 		u16 length;
64: 
65: 		(void)rtos_get_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
66: 		do
67: 		{
68: 			length = bk_mb_uart_read(MB_UART0, buffer, sizeof(buffer));
69: 			if (length != 0)
70: 			{
71: 				if (bk_uart_write_bytes(UART_ID_0, buffer, length) != BK_OK)
72: 				{
73: 					s_ap_uart0_log_write_fail++;
74: 				}
75: 			}
76: 		} while (length != 0);
77: 	}
78: }
79: 
80: static bk_err_t ap_uart0_log_init(void)
81: {
82: 	bk_err_t ret;
83: 
84: 	ret = rtos_init_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem, 1);
85: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
86: 	{
87: 		return ret;
88: 	}
89: 
90: 	ret = rtos_create_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread,
91: 					 BEKEN_DEFAULT_WORKER_PRIORITY,
92: 					 "ap_uart0_log", ap_uart0_log_task, 2048, NULL);
93: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
94: 	{
95: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
96: 		return ret;
97: 	}
98: 
99: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_dev_init(MB_UART0);
100: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
101: 	{
102: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
103: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
104: 		return ret;
105: 	}
106: 
107: 	ret = bk_mb_uart_register_rx_isr(MB_UART0, ap_uart0_log_rx, NULL);
108: 	if (ret != BK_OK)
109: 	{
110: 		bk_mb_uart_dev_deinit(MB_UART0);
111: 		rtos_delete_thread(&s_ap_uart0_log_thread);
112: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
113: 		return ret;
114: 	}
115: 
116: 	/* Drain data that may have arrived between channel open and callback
117: 	 * registration. The binary semaphore intentionally coalesces wakeups. */
118: 	(void)rtos_set_semaphore(&s_ap_uart0_log_sem);
119: 	return BK_OK;
120: }

1: # Repo 多仓库开发与 Git 管理
2: 
3: ## 1. 目录和职责
4: 
5: 工作区：
6: 
7: ```text
8: ~/vela_competition/contest/
9: ├── .repo/                                      # repo 元数据，不提交
10: ├── nuttx/ apps/ packages/ vendor/              # openvela 公共仓库
11: └── contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/
12:                                                    # 比赛仓，唯一提交仓库
13: ```
14: 
15: 核心原则：
16: 
17: - `repo` 负责组织多个 Git 仓库；Git 负责版本管理。
18: - BK7258 源码只维护在比赛仓 `board/beken/` 下。
19: - `nuttx/`、`apps/`、`packages/` 和公共 `vendor/` 默认不修改、不提交。
20: - `vendor/beken/` 下的 BK7258 目录是 manifest 创建的构建入口，不是源码提交位置。
21: 
22: ## 2. 初始化工作区
23: 
24: 在新的工作区根目录执行，不要在比赛仓子目录中执行 `repo init`：
25: 
26: ```bash
27: mkdir -p ~/vela_competition/contest
28: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
29: 
30: repo init \
31:   -u https://github.com/open-vela/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing \
32:   -b dev-ai-contest-2026 \
33:   -m contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing.xml
34: 
35: repo sync -c -j8
36: repo status
37: ```
38: 
39: 比赛仓路径：
40: 
41: ```text
42: ~/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/
43: ```
44: 
45: ## 3. 使用开发分支
46: 
47: ```bash
48: cd ~/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing
49: git switch dev-ai-contest-2026
50: git branch --show-current
51: git status --short --branch
52: ```
53: 
54: 日常开发使用比赛仓的 `dev-ai-contest-2026` 或从该分支创建的功能分支。
55: 
56: ## 4. 源码位置和 manifest 映射
57: 
58: 当前 BK7258 映射为：
59: 
60: ```xml
61: <linkfile src="board/beken/chips/bk7258"
62:           dest="vendor/beken/chips/bk7258"/>
63: <linkfile src="board/beken/boards/bk7258"
64:           dest="vendor/beken/boards/bk7258"/>
65: ```
66: 
67: 对应关系：
68: 
69: ```text
70: 比赛仓/board/beken/chips/bk7258/
71:     -> 工作区/vendor/beken/chips/bk7258/
72: 
73: 比赛仓/board/beken/boards/bk7258/
74:     -> 工作区/vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/
75: ```
76: 
77: 源码应放在：
78: 
79: ```text
80: contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/board/beken/
81: ```
82: 
83: 不要直接把代码放到：
84: 
85: ```text
86: contest/vendor/beken/
87: contest/nuttx/
88: contest/apps/
89: contest/packages/
90: ```
91: 
92: 如果新增源码目录，必须同时在比赛仓 manifest 中增加对应的 `<linkfile>`，然后同步并检查映射：
93: 
94: ```bash
95: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
96: repo sync -c
97: ls -ld vendor/beken/chips/bk7258
98: readlink vendor/beken/chips/bk7258
99: ```
100: 
101: ## 5. 日常开发和构建
102: 
103: 编辑比赛仓中的源码：
104: 
105: ```text
106: board/beken/chips/bk7258/
107: board/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/
108: ```
109: 
110: BK7258 显式构建：
111: 
112: ```bash
113: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
114: source build/envsetup.sh
115: lunch vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh
116: m -j8
117: ```
118: 
119: 使用 CMake：
120: 
121: ```bash
122: ./build.sh \
123:   vendor/beken/boards/bk7258/bk7258-ap/configs/nsh \
124:   --cmake \
125:   -j8
126: ```
127: 
128: `lunch` 菜单只显示已注册的公共 vendorsetup 组合，不代表 BK7258 不存在。BK7258 使用上面的显式路径。
129: 
130: ### 5.1 同步CP日志桥接修改
131: 
132: OpenVela AP日志通过Mailbox UART转发到Beken CP，再由CP物理UART0输出。CP源码位于外部`bk_avdk_smp`仓库，不复制进`board/beken/`；比赛仓通过补丁保存并复现必要修改：
133: 
134: ```text
135: patches/bk_avdk_smp/0001-cp-bridge-ap-mailbox-logs-to-uart0.patch
136: ```
137: 
138: 该补丁面向`bk_avdk_smp`原厂基线提交`aa5df96`。在SDK根目录执行：
139: 
140: ```bash
141: git apply --check \
142:   ../contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/patches/bk_avdk_smp/0001-cp-bridge-ap-mailbox-logs-to-uart0.patch
143: 
144: git apply \
145:   ../contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/patches/bk_avdk_smp/0001-cp-bridge-ap-mailbox-logs-to-uart0.patch
146: ```
147: 
148: 如果`git apply --check`失败，先检查`cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c`是否已有`ap_uart0_log_init`，禁止重复应用。补丁细节和验证步骤见`patches/bk_avdk_smp/README.md`。
149: 
150: ## 6. 正确提交
151: 
152: ```bash
153: cd ~/vela_competition/contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing
154: 
155: git status --short
156: git diff --check
157: 
158: git add board/beken
159: git add contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing.xml
160: git add git教程.md
161: 
162: git diff --cached --name-only
163: git commit -m "feat: complete BK7258 porting milestone"
164: 
165: git status --short --branch
166: git log --oneline -5
167: ```
168: 
169: 暂存内容只能来自比赛仓。提交中不应出现：
170: 
171: ```text
172: nuttx/
173: apps/
174: packages/
175: vendor/
176: .repo/
177: cmake_out/
178: out/
179: ```
180: 
181: 提交到远端：
182: 
183: ```bash
184: git push origin dev-ai-contest-2026
185: ```
186: 
187: ## 7. 功能分支
188: 
189: ```bash
190: git switch dev-ai-contest-2026
191: git switch -c feature/bk7258-startup
192: 
193: git status
194: git diff --check
195: git diff dev-ai-contest-2026...HEAD --stat
196: ```
197: 
198: 完成后合并回 `dev-ai-contest-2026`：
199: 
200: ```bash
201: git switch dev-ai-contest-2026
202: git merge --no-ff feature/bk7258-startup
203: ```
204: 
205: 不建议执行：
206: 
207: ```bash
208: repo start dev-ai-contest-2026 --all
209: ```
210: 
211: 它会给所有公共仓库创建额外分支。
212: 
213: ## 8. 检查公共仓库
214: 
215: ```bash
216: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
217: repo status
218: git -C nuttx status
219: git -C vendor/beken status
220: git -C apps status
221: ```
222: 
223: 公共仓库出现修改时：
224: 
225: - BK7258 移植代码放回比赛仓 `board/beken/`。
226: - openvela 公共功能在对应公共仓库单独建分支、提交和发 PR。
227: - 不要复制公共仓库文件到比赛仓来掩盖公共仓修改。
228: 
229: ## 9. 同步上游
230: 
231: 同步前先检查：
232: 
233: ```bash
234: cd ~/vela_competition/contest
235: repo status
236: ```
237: 
238: 同步：
239: 
240: ```bash
241: repo sync -c -j8
242: ```
243: 
244: 不要在未确认本地修改可丢弃时执行：
245: 
246: ```bash
247: git reset --hard
248: git checkout -- .
249: repo sync --force-sync
250: ```
251: 
252: ## 10. 标签和日志
253: 
254: 阶段完成后可在比赛仓创建标签：
255: 
256: ```bash
257: git tag -a bk7258-startup -m "BK7258 startup baseline"
258: git tag
259: ```
260: 
261: AI Coding 日志放在：
262: 
263: ```text
264: contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/logs/
265: ```
266: 
267: 不要把日志放到 `.repo/`，也不要提交构建临时日志。
268: 
269: ## 11. 最终原则
270: 
271: - 比赛仓是参赛代码的唯一提交仓库。
272: - Git 管理比赛仓源码和 manifest；manifest 管理工作区映射。
273: - 软链接或 linkfile 只是构建入口，不是另一份源码。
274: - 每次提交前检查 `git diff --cached --name-only`。
275: - 每个阶段完成后检查 `repo status`。
276: - 公共仓库需要修改时，单独管理、单独提交、单独发 PR。

(End of file - total 276 lines)
</content>

1: # BK7258 CP patches
2: 
3: This directory tracks the minimal changes required in the external Beken
4: `bk_avdk_smp` SDK. The OpenVela AP sources remain under `board/beken/`.
5: 
6: ## AP log bridge
7: 
8: `0001-cp-bridge-ap-mailbox-logs-to-uart0.patch` applies to the Beken SDK
9: baseline commit `aa5df96`. It opens CP `MB_UART0`, drains AP log data from a
10: worker thread, and writes it to physical UART0 without blocking the mailbox
11: receive callback.
12: 
13: Apply from the `bk_avdk_smp` repository root:
14: 
15: ```bash
16: git apply --check \
17:   ../contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/patches/bk_avdk_smp/0001-cp-bridge-ap-mailbox-logs-to-uart0.patch
18:

20:   ../contest/contest2026_264_VelaSightsuixingAIzhinengyanjing/patches/bk_avdk_smp/0001-cp-bridge-ap-mailbox-logs-to-uart0.patch
21: ```
22: 
23: If `git apply --check` reports that the patch does not apply, first check
24: whether `cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c` already contains
25: `ap_uart0_log_init`. Do not apply the patch twice.
26: 
27: Verify the applied source without changing it:
28: 
29: ```bash
30: git diff --check
31: git diff -- cp/middleware/driver/common/driver.c
32: ```
33: 
34: The currently validated local SDK carries the equivalent changes in commits
35: `6bfc6e7`, `85e0476`, and `d203f9f`.
